mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and INDPRO declines.
